fact: On 9 January 2023 the CNDP stated that TLScontact had made unnotified transfers of video-surveillance images abroad, an offence under law 09-08, and required it to bring all its processing into compliance by 28 February 2023.
title: Communiqué de presse : Infraction à la loi 09-08 suite à absence de notification à la CNDP
publisher: Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des Données à caractère Personnel (CNDP)
